summary.content:
Today's selection covers 54 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 38 on Artificial Intelligence and 9 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Nvidia, Microsoft launch open AI security alliance — without OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Coca-Cola Confirms Data Breach After Fairlife Ransomware Attack
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, SecurityWeek, TechCrunch, NY Times Tech, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 19 articles published in the last 24 hours
